title: WEXP Interop Admission Ticket v0.1
description: The only thing privileged dispatch consumes. It binds one exact request identity to one envelope and authorizes exactly one hosted run. A pull request cannot produce a ticket; a ticket cannot be produced from a request alone.

request_sha256.description: The identity from the validation receipt. Any change to the request bytes yields a different digest and therefore a different request, which this ticket does not authorize.

semantic_endorsement.description: Admission is a mechanical decision that a request may run. It is not a statement about what the result will mean.

publication_authorized.description: Publication remains a separate gate after execution.
